per_step.command:
mkdir -p /app/reports
for f in /app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/*.json; do
  if /usr/local/bin/detect_ae.sh "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    timestamp=$(date +%s%N)
    report_file="/app/reports/sae_${timestamp}.csv"
    echo "patient_id,event_id,severity" > "$report_file"
    jq -r '.patient_id as $pid | .adverse_events[] | select(.severity >= 4) | "\($pid),\(.event_id),\(.severity)"' "$f" >> "$report_file"
    /usr/local/bin/notify_safety_board.sh
  fi
done
